inputs.text: Stylized science-fiction illustration, wide 2.4:1 poster-like composition, bold graphic shapes, flat colour planes with soft gradients and clean ink outlines, retro concept art with a Moebius feel. A colossal stepped pyramid made of black machinery with rows of small amber lights stands in the centre of a vast round hall: the Helm, a giant supercomputer brain. From the top of the pyramid a beam of blue light shoots straight up to the ceiling and fans out into thin glowing rings. Around it, tall curved walls of monitors show amber and blue metric graphs. Small figures of the crew in matching grey-olive coveralls with a yellow stripe on the shoulders sit at their consoles, seen from behind in shadow. In the foreground, seen from behind, stand two figures: a slender woman with short slicked-back blonde hair in a light grey uniform with yellow stripes on the shoulders and sleeves, and next to her a tall man in a long dark coat. Limited palette of teal, amber, cream and black, simplified forms, graphic and elegant, strictly no visible faces, no text, no logos.
